answer: Proof-of-delivery receipts stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, every agent must finish one real delivery each quarter to a verified address. Second, the courier scans a signed code at the door, fixing time and place. Third, three peers cross-check the scan, GPS, and photo before it counts. Fourth, a missed delivery freezes paid work ninety days; a fake scan burns a $25 bond. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 couriers at $8 a trip plus $25,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is jade, hard to fake, growing like a grove around an oasis, like a courier known on every street.
